locks.text: Swift CharterFuture Swift Ascension levels from level 10 cost 6 times the current level in Prisms. Keeps every existing +4% bonus.Unlocks at Rift 100 · Swift Ascension level 10
Lumen InheritanceKeep 5% of your current Lumen per level when you Ascend, up to 50,000 Lumen per level. An empty wallet stays empty.Unlocks at Rift 15
Veteran RecruitsFuture first recruitment and Ember after Ascend start 1 level higher per rank. Pay only the recruitment price; bonus levels are not paid Empowers.Unlocks at Rift 20
Roster RecallAfter Ascend, recruit one additional remembered Formation member per level who was recruited in the ending run. Uses Veteran Recruits. Pauses when starting Single Star.Unlocks at Rift 25
Charge MemoryKeep 20% of each Wisp’s charge per level through Ascend, up to 100%. Dormant charge waits for recruitment.Unlocks at Rift 30
Lasting BlessingsKeep current Support blessings through Ascend with their existing strength and expiry. Never refreshes or extends a cast.Unlocks at Rift 60
Unbroken RhythmKeep the elapsed part of Auto-Tap and Auto-Empower’s current second through Ascend. Requires their existing Deed unlocks.Unlocks at Rift 40
Familiar PathsStart 1 Rift further ahead per level after Ascend, up to Rift 6. Skipped enemies give no rewards or kill credit.Unlocks at Rift 30
Frontier RecordGain 1 extra Prism per level for each new block of 25 cleared Rifts beyond your rewarded benchmark. Repeated Rifts give no extra award.Unlocks at Rift 50
Ascension DustEvery 20 Prisms earned in an Ascend also gives 1 Mote per level, up to 10 Motes per level. No Prisms are spent.Unlocks at Rift 60
Patient GrowthAbove Wisp level 25, reduce future Empower price growth from 13% to 12% per level at rank 1, down to 8% at rank 5. Cheaper Recruitment still applies.Unlocks at Rift 40
Sixth CompanionChoose up to 6 Active Wisps in your Formation and saved presets. Wisps still require recruitment.Unlocks at Rift 75

Bench MentorshipEvery 10 paid recruit or Empower actions give 1 level per rank to the lowest-level other recruited Benched Wisp. Progress resets at Ascend; bonus levels never repeat the award.Unlocks at Rift 35
Steady InstructionAuto-Empower can make 1 extra paid purchase per second per level, up to 5 purchases. Respects each Wisp’s toggle and existing unlock.Unlocks at Rift 45
Wall WisdomAn unwinnable boss can trigger offline retreat 1 minute earlier per level, from 5 minutes to a 1-minute minimum. The 12-hour offline cap stays the same.Unlocks at Rift 50
Early InvitationsRecruitment unlocks arrive 1 Rift earlier per level, down to Rift 1. Permanent Wisp upgrade prices stay the same.Unlocks at Rift 15

Recruitment ReserveAuto-Empower prioritizes the next enabled recruit in your remembered Formation. Until affordable, reserve 20% of its Lumen price per level from other automatic Empowers.Unlocks at Rift 25

locks.text: Swift CharterFuture Swift Ascension levels from level 10 cost 6 times the current level in Prisms. Keeps every existing +4% bonus.Unlocks at Rift 100 · Swift Ascension level 10
Lumen InheritanceKeep 5% of your current Lumen per level when you Ascend, up to 50,000 Lumen per level. An empty wallet stays empty.Unlocks at Rift 15
Veteran RecruitsFuture first recruitment and Ember after Ascend start 1 level higher per rank. Pay only the recruitment price; bonus levels are not paid Empowers.Unlocks at Rift 20
Roster RecallAfter Ascend, recruit one additional remembered Formation member per level who was recruited in the ending run. Uses Veteran Recruits. Pauses when starting Single Star.Unlocks at Rift 25
Charge MemoryKeep 20% of each Wisp’s charge per level through Ascend, up to 100%. Dormant charge waits for recruitment.Unlocks at Rift 30
Lasting BlessingsKeep current Support blessings through Ascend with their existing strength and expiry. Never refreshes or extends a cast.Unlocks at Rift 60
Unbroken RhythmKeep the elapsed part of Auto-Tap and Auto-Empower’s current second through Ascend. Requires their existing Deed unlocks.Unlocks at Rift 40
Familiar PathsStart 1 Rift further ahead per level after Ascend, up to Rift 6. Skipped enemies give no rewards or kill credit.Unlocks at Rift 30
Frontier RecordGain 1 extra Prism per level for each new block of 25 cleared Rifts beyond your rewarded benchmark. Repeated Rifts give no extra award.Unlocks at Rift 50
Ascension DustEvery 20 Prisms earned in an Ascend also gives 1 Mote per level, up to 10 Motes per level. No Prisms are spent.Unlocks at Rift 60
Patient GrowthAbove Wisp level 25, reduce future Empower price growth from 13% to 12% per level at rank 1, down to 8% at rank 5. Cheaper Recruitment still applies.Unlocks at Rift 40
Sixth CompanionChoose up to 6 Active Wisps in your Formation and saved presets. Wisps still require recruitment.Unlocks at Rift 75

Bench MentorshipEvery 10 paid recruit or Empower actions give 1 level per rank to the lowest-level other recruited Benched Wisp. Progress resets at Ascend; bonus levels never repeat the award.Unlocks at Rift 35
Steady InstructionAuto-Empower can make 1 extra paid purchase per second per level, up to 5 purchases. Respects each Wisp’s toggle and existing unlock.Unlocks at Rift 45
Wall WisdomAn unwinnable boss can trigger offline retreat 1 minute earlier per level, from 5 minutes to a 1-minute minimum. The 12-hour offline cap stays the same.Unlocks at Rift 50
Early InvitationsRecruitment unlocks arrive 1 Rift earlier per level, down to Rift 1. Permanent Wisp upgrade prices stay the same.Unlocks at Rift 15

Recruitment ReserveAuto-Empower prioritizes the next enabled recruit in your remembered Formation. Until affordable, reserve 20% of its Lumen price per level from other automatic Empowers.Unlocks at Rift 25

locks.text: Swift CharterFuture Swift Ascension levels from level 10 cost 6 times the current level in Prisms. Keeps every existing +4% bonus.Unlocks at Rift 100 · Swift Ascension level 10
Lumen InheritanceKeep 5% of your current Lumen per level when you Ascend, up to 50,000 Lumen per level. An empty wallet stays empty.Unlocks at Rift 15
Veteran RecruitsFuture first recruitment and Ember after Ascend start 1 level higher per rank. Pay only the recruitment price; bonus levels are not paid Empowers.Unlocks at Rift 20
Roster RecallAfter Ascend, recruit one additional remembered Formation member per level who was recruited in the ending run. Uses Veteran Recruits. Pauses when starting Single Star.Unlocks at Rift 25
Charge MemoryKeep 20% of each Wisp’s charge per level through Ascend, up to 100%. Dormant charge waits for recruitment.Unlocks at Rift 30
Lasting BlessingsKeep current Support blessings through Ascend with their existing strength and expiry. Never refreshes or extends a cast.Unlocks at Rift 60
Unbroken RhythmKeep the elapsed part of Auto-Tap and Auto-Empower’s current second through Ascend. Requires their existing Deed unlocks.Unlocks at Rift 40
Familiar PathsStart 1 Rift further ahead per level after Ascend, up to Rift 6. Skipped enemies give no rewards or kill credit.Unlocks at Rift 30
Frontier RecordGain 1 extra Prism per level for each new block of 25 cleared Rifts beyond your rewarded benchmark. Repeated Rifts give no extra award.Unlocks at Rift 50
Ascension DustEvery 20 Prisms earned in an Ascend also gives 1 Mote per level, up to 10 Motes per level. No Prisms are spent.Unlocks at Rift 60
Patient GrowthAbove Wisp level 25, reduce future Empower price growth from 13% to 12% per level at rank 1, down to 8% at rank 5. Cheaper Recruitment still applies.Unlocks at Rift 40
Sixth CompanionChoose up to 6 Active Wisps in your Formation and saved presets. Wisps still require recruitment.Unlocks at Rift 75

Bench MentorshipEvery 10 paid recruit or Empower actions give 1 level per rank to the lowest-level other recruited Benched Wisp. Progress resets at Ascend; bonus levels never repeat the award.Unlocks at Rift 35
Steady InstructionAuto-Empower can make 1 extra paid purchase per second per level, up to 5 purchases. Respects each Wisp’s toggle and existing unlock.Unlocks at Rift 45
Wall WisdomAn unwinnable boss can trigger offline retreat 1 minute earlier per level, from 5 minutes to a 1-minute minimum. The 12-hour offline cap stays the same.Unlocks at Rift 50
Early InvitationsRecruitment unlocks arrive 1 Rift earlier per level, down to Rift 1. Permanent Wisp upgrade prices stay the same.Unlocks at Rift 15

Recruitment ReserveAuto-Empower prioritizes the next enabled recruit in your remembered Formation. Until affordable, reserve 20% of its Lumen price per level from other automatic Empowers.Unlocks at Rift 25

locks.text: Swift CharterFuture Swift Ascension levels from level 10 cost 6 times the current level in Prisms. Keeps every existing +4% bonus.Unlocks at Rift 100 · Swift Ascension level 10
Lumen InheritanceKeep 5% of your current Lumen per level when you Ascend, up to 50,000 Lumen per level. An empty wallet stays empty.Unlocks at Rift 15
Veteran RecruitsFuture first recruitment and Ember after Ascend start 1 level higher per rank. Pay only the recruitment price; bonus levels are not paid Empowers.Unlocks at Rift 20
Roster RecallAfter Ascend, recruit one additional remembered Formation member per level who was recruited in the ending run. Uses Veteran Recruits. Pauses when starting Single Star.Unlocks at Rift 25
Charge MemoryKeep 20% of each Wisp’s charge per level through Ascend, up to 100%. Dormant charge waits for recruitment.Unlocks at Rift 30
Lasting BlessingsKeep current Support blessings through Ascend with their existing strength and expiry. Never refreshes or extends a cast.Unlocks at Rift 60
Unbroken RhythmKeep the elapsed part of Auto-Tap and Auto-Empower’s current second through Ascend. Requires their existing Deed unlocks.Unlocks at Rift 40
Familiar PathsStart 1 Rift further ahead per level after Ascend, up to Rift 6. Skipped enemies give no rewards or kill credit.Unlocks at Rift 30
Frontier RecordGain 1 extra Prism per level for each new block of 25 cleared Rifts beyond your rewarded benchmark. Repeated Rifts give no extra award.Unlocks at Rift 50
Ascension DustEvery 20 Prisms earned in an Ascend also gives 1 Mote per level, up to 10 Motes per level. No Prisms are spent.Unlocks at Rift 60
Patient GrowthAbove Wisp level 25, reduce future Empower price growth from 13% to 12% per level at rank 1, down to 8% at rank 5. Cheaper Recruitment still applies.Unlocks at Rift 40
Sixth CompanionChoose up to 6 Active Wisps in your Formation and saved presets. Wisps still require recruitment.Unlocks at Rift 75

Bench MentorshipEvery 10 paid recruit or Empower actions give 1 level per rank to the lowest-level other recruited Benched Wisp. Progress resets at Ascend; bonus levels never repeat the award.Unlocks at Rift 35
Steady InstructionAuto-Empower can make 1 extra paid purchase per second per level, up to 5 purchases. Respects each Wisp’s toggle and existing unlock.Unlocks at Rift 45
Wall WisdomAn unwinnable boss can trigger offline retreat 1 minute earlier per level, from 5 minutes to a 1-minute minimum. The 12-hour offline cap stays the same.Unlocks at Rift 50
Early InvitationsRecruitment unlocks arrive 1 Rift earlier per level, down to Rift 1. Permanent Wisp upgrade prices stay the same.Unlocks at Rift 15

Recruitment ReserveAuto-Empower prioritizes the next enabled recruit in your remembered Formation. Until affordable, reserve 20% of its Lumen price per level from other automatic Empowers.Unlocks at Rift 25

locks.text: Swift CharterFuture Swift Ascension levels from level 10 cost 6 times the current level in Prisms. Keeps every existing +4% bonus.Unlocks at Rift 100 · Swift Ascension level 10
Lumen InheritanceKeep 5% of your current Lumen per level when you Ascend, up to 50,000 Lumen per level. An empty wallet stays empty.Unlocks at Rift 15
Veteran RecruitsFuture first recruitment and Ember after Ascend start 1 level higher per rank. Pay only the recruitment price; bonus levels are not paid Empowers.Unlocks at Rift 20
Roster RecallAfter Ascend, recruit one additional remembered Formation member per level who was recruited in the ending run. Uses Veteran Recruits. Pauses when starting Single Star.Unlocks at Rift 25
Charge MemoryKeep 20% of each Wisp’s charge per level through Ascend, up to 100%. Dormant charge waits for recruitment.Unlocks at Rift 30
Lasting BlessingsKeep current Support blessings through Ascend with their existing strength and expiry. Never refreshes or extends a cast.Unlocks at Rift 60
Unbroken RhythmKeep the elapsed part of Auto-Tap and Auto-Empower’s current second through Ascend. Requires their existing Deed unlocks.Unlocks at Rift 40
Familiar PathsStart 1 Rift further ahead per level after Ascend, up to Rift 6. Skipped enemies give no rewards or kill credit.Unlocks at Rift 30
Frontier RecordGain 1 extra Prism per level for each new block of 25 cleared Rifts beyond your rewarded benchmark. Repeated Rifts give no extra award.Unlocks at Rift 50
Ascension DustEvery 20 Prisms earned in an Ascend also gives 1 Mote per level, up to 10 Motes per level. No Prisms are spent.Unlocks at Rift 60
Patient GrowthAbove Wisp level 25, reduce future Empower price growth from 13% to 12% per level at rank 1, down to 8% at rank 5. Cheaper Recruitment still applies.Unlocks at Rift 40
Sixth CompanionChoose up to 6 Active Wisps in your Formation and saved presets. Wisps still require recruitment.Unlocks at Rift 75

Bench MentorshipEvery 10 paid recruit or Empower actions give 1 level per rank to the lowest-level other recruited Benched Wisp. Progress resets at Ascend; bonus levels never repeat the award.Unlocks at Rift 35
Steady InstructionAuto-Empower can make 1 extra paid purchase per second per level, up to 5 purchases. Respects each Wisp’s toggle and existing unlock.Unlocks at Rift 45
Wall WisdomAn unwinnable boss can trigger offline retreat 1 minute earlier per level, from 5 minutes to a 1-minute minimum. The 12-hour offline cap stays the same.Unlocks at Rift 50
Early InvitationsRecruitment unlocks arrive 1 Rift earlier per level, down to Rift 1. Permanent Wisp upgrade prices stay the same.Unlocks at Rift 15

Recruitment ReserveAuto-Empower prioritizes the next enabled recruit in your remembered Formation. Until affordable, reserve 20% of its Lumen price per level from other automatic Empowers.Unlocks at Rift 25

locks.text: Swift CharterFuture Swift Ascension levels from level 10 cost 6 times the current level in Prisms. Keeps every existing +4% bonus.Unlocks at Rift 100 · Swift Ascension level 10
Lumen InheritanceKeep 5% of your current Lumen per level when you Ascend, up to 50,000 Lumen per level. An empty wallet stays empty.Unlocks at Rift 15
Veteran RecruitsFuture first recruitment and Ember after Ascend start 1 level higher per rank. Pay only the recruitment price; bonus levels are not paid Empowers.Unlocks at Rift 20
Roster RecallAfter Ascend, recruit one additional remembered Formation member per level who was recruited in the ending run. Uses Veteran Recruits. Pauses when starting Single Star.Unlocks at Rift 25
Charge MemoryKeep 20% of each Wisp’s charge per level through Ascend, up to 100%. Dormant charge waits for recruitment.Unlocks at Rift 30
Lasting BlessingsKeep current Support blessings through Ascend with their existing strength and expiry. Never refreshes or extends a cast.Unlocks at Rift 60
Unbroken RhythmKeep the elapsed part of Auto-Tap and Auto-Empower’s current second through Ascend. Requires their existing Deed unlocks.Unlocks at Rift 40
Familiar PathsStart 1 Rift further ahead per level after Ascend, up to Rift 6. Skipped enemies give no rewards or kill credit.Unlocks at Rift 30
Frontier RecordGain 1 extra Prism per level for each new block of 25 cleared Rifts beyond your rewarded benchmark. Repeated Rifts give no extra award.Unlocks at Rift 50
Ascension DustEvery 20 Prisms earned in an Ascend also gives 1 Mote per level, up to 10 Motes per level. No Prisms are spent.Unlocks at Rift 60
Patient GrowthAbove Wisp level 25, reduce future Empower price growth from 13% to 12% per level at rank 1, down to 8% at rank 5. Cheaper Recruitment still applies.Unlocks at Rift 40
Sixth CompanionChoose up to 6 Active Wisps in your Formation and saved presets. Wisps still require recruitment.Unlocks at Rift 75

Bench MentorshipEvery 10 paid recruit or Empower actions give 1 level per rank to the lowest-level other recruited Benched Wisp. Progress resets at Ascend; bonus levels never repeat the award.Unlocks at Rift 35
Steady InstructionAuto-Empower can make 1 extra paid purchase per second per level, up to 5 purchases. Respects each Wisp’s toggle and existing unlock.Unlocks at Rift 45
Wall WisdomAn unwinnable boss can trigger offline retreat 1 minute earlier per level, from 5 minutes to a 1-minute minimum. The 12-hour offline cap stays the same.Unlocks at Rift 50
Early InvitationsRecruitment unlocks arrive 1 Rift earlier per level, down to Rift 1. Permanent Wisp upgrade prices stay the same.Unlocks at Rift 15

Recruitment ReserveAuto-Empower prioritizes the next enabled recruit in your remembered Formation. Until affordable, reserve 20% of its Lumen price per level from other automatic Empowers.Unlocks at Rift 25

locks.text: Swift CharterFuture Swift Ascension levels from level 10 cost 6 times the current level in Prisms. Keeps every existing +4% bonus.Unlocks at Rift 100 · Swift Ascension level 10
Lumen InheritanceKeep 5% of your current Lumen per level when you Ascend, up to 50,000 Lumen per level. An empty wallet stays empty.Unlocks at Rift 15
Veteran RecruitsFuture first recruitment and Ember after Ascend start 1 level higher per rank. Pay only the recruitment price; bonus levels are not paid Empowers.Unlocks at Rift 20
Roster RecallAfter Ascend, recruit one additional remembered Formation member per level who was recruited in the ending run. Uses Veteran Recruits. Pauses when starting Single Star.Unlocks at Rift 25
Charge MemoryKeep 20% of each Wisp’s charge per level through Ascend, up to 100%. Dormant charge waits for recruitment.Unlocks at Rift 30
Lasting BlessingsKeep current Support blessings through Ascend with their existing strength and expiry. Never refreshes or extends a cast.Unlocks at Rift 60
Unbroken RhythmKeep the elapsed part of Auto-Tap and Auto-Empower’s current second through Ascend. Requires their existing Deed unlocks.Unlocks at Rift 40
Familiar PathsStart 1 Rift further ahead per level after Ascend, up to Rift 6. Skipped enemies give no rewards or kill credit.Unlocks at Rift 30
Frontier RecordGain 1 extra Prism per level for each new block of 25 cleared Rifts beyond your rewarded benchmark. Repeated Rifts give no extra award.Unlocks at Rift 50
Ascension DustEvery 20 Prisms earned in an Ascend also gives 1 Mote per level, up to 10 Motes per level. No Prisms are spent.Unlocks at Rift 60
Patient GrowthAbove Wisp level 25, reduce future Empower price growth from 13% to 12% per level at rank 1, down to 8% at rank 5. Cheaper Recruitment still applies.Unlocks at Rift 40
Sixth CompanionChoose up to 6 Active Wisps in your Formation and saved presets. Wisps still require recruitment.Unlocks at Rift 75

Bench MentorshipEvery 10 paid recruit or Empower actions give 1 level per rank to the lowest-level other recruited Benched Wisp. Progress resets at Ascend; bonus levels never repeat the award.Unlocks at Rift 35
Steady InstructionAuto-Empower can make 1 extra paid purchase per second per level, up to 5 purchases. Respects each Wisp’s toggle and existing unlock.Unlocks at Rift 45
Wall WisdomAn unwinnable boss can trigger offline retreat 1 minute earlier per level, from 5 minutes to a 1-minute minimum. The 12-hour offline cap stays the same.Unlocks at Rift 50
Early InvitationsRecruitment unlocks arrive 1 Rift earlier per level, down to Rift 1. Permanent Wisp upgrade prices stay the same.Unlocks at Rift 15

Recruitment ReserveAuto-Empower prioritizes the next enabled recruit in your remembered Formation. Until affordable, reserve 20% of its Lumen price per level from other automatic Empowers.Unlocks at Rift 25

locks.text: Swift CharterFuture Swift Ascension levels from level 10 cost 6 times the current level in Prisms. Keeps every existing +4% bonus.Unlocks at Rift 100 · Swift Ascension level 10
Lumen InheritanceKeep 5% of your current Lumen per level when you Ascend, up to 50,000 Lumen per level. An empty wallet stays empty.Unlocks at Rift 15
Veteran RecruitsFuture first recruitment and Ember after Ascend start 1 level higher per rank. Pay only the recruitment price; bonus levels are not paid Empowers.Unlocks at Rift 20
Roster RecallAfter Ascend, recruit one additional remembered Formation member per level who was recruited in the ending run. Uses Veteran Recruits. Pauses when starting Single Star.Unlocks at Rift 25
Charge MemoryKeep 20% of each Wisp’s charge per level through Ascend, up to 100%. Dormant charge waits for recruitment.Unlocks at Rift 30
Lasting BlessingsKeep current Support blessings through Ascend with their existing strength and expiry. Never refreshes or extends a cast.Unlocks at Rift 60
Unbroken RhythmKeep the elapsed part of Auto-Tap and Auto-Empower’s current second through Ascend. Requires their existing Deed unlocks.Unlocks at Rift 40
Familiar PathsStart 1 Rift further ahead per level after Ascend, up to Rift 6. Skipped enemies give no rewards or kill credit.Unlocks at Rift 30
Frontier RecordGain 1 extra Prism per level for each new block of 25 cleared Rifts beyond your rewarded benchmark. Repeated Rifts give no extra award.Unlocks at Rift 50
Ascension DustEvery 20 Prisms earned in an Ascend also gives 1 Mote per level, up to 10 Motes per level. No Prisms are spent.Unlocks at Rift 60
Patient GrowthAbove Wisp level 25, reduce future Empower price growth from 13% to 12% per level at rank 1, down to 8% at rank 5. Cheaper Recruitment still applies.Unlocks at Rift 40
Sixth CompanionChoose up to 6 Active Wisps in your Formation and saved presets. Wisps still require recruitment.Unlocks at Rift 75

Bench MentorshipEvery 10 paid recruit or Empower actions give 1 level per rank to the lowest-level other recruited Benched Wisp. Progress resets at Ascend; bonus levels never repeat the award.Unlocks at Rift 35
Steady InstructionAuto-Empower can make 1 extra paid purchase per second per level, up to 5 purchases. Respects each Wisp’s toggle and existing unlock.Unlocks at Rift 45
Wall WisdomAn unwinnable boss can trigger offline retreat 1 minute earlier per level, from 5 minutes to a 1-minute minimum. The 12-hour offline cap stays the same.Unlocks at Rift 50
Early InvitationsRecruitment unlocks arrive 1 Rift earlier per level, down to Rift 1. Permanent Wisp upgrade prices stay the same.Unlocks at Rift 15

Recruitment ReserveAuto-Empower prioritizes the next enabled recruit in your remembered Formation. Until affordable, reserve 20% of its Lumen price per level from other automatic Empowers.Unlocks at Rift 25

locks.text: Swift CharterFuture Swift Ascension levels from level 10 cost 6 times the current level in Prisms. Keeps every existing +4% bonus.Unlocks at Rift 100 · Swift Ascension level 10
Lumen InheritanceKeep 5% of your current Lumen per level when you Ascend, up to 50,000 Lumen per level. An empty wallet stays empty.Unlocks at Rift 15
Veteran RecruitsFuture first recruitment and Ember after Ascend start 1 level higher per rank. Pay only the recruitment price; bonus levels are not paid Empowers.Unlocks at Rift 20
Roster RecallAfter Ascend, recruit one additional remembered Formation member per level who was recruited in the ending run. Uses Veteran Recruits. Pauses when starting Single Star.Unlocks at Rift 25
Charge MemoryKeep 20% of each Wisp’s charge per level through Ascend, up to 100%. Dormant charge waits for recruitment.Unlocks at Rift 30
Lasting BlessingsKeep current Support blessings through Ascend with their existing strength and expiry. Never refreshes or extends a cast.Unlocks at Rift 60
Unbroken RhythmKeep the elapsed part of Auto-Tap and Auto-Empower’s current second through Ascend. Requires their existing Deed unlocks.Unlocks at Rift 40
Familiar PathsStart 1 Rift further ahead per level after Ascend, up to Rift 6. Skipped enemies give no rewards or kill credit.Unlocks at Rift 30
Frontier RecordGain 1 extra Prism per level for each new block of 25 cleared Rifts beyond your rewarded benchmark. Repeated Rifts give no extra award.Unlocks at Rift 50
Ascension DustEvery 20 Prisms earned in an Ascend also gives 1 Mote per level, up to 10 Motes per level. No Prisms are spent.Unlocks at Rift 60
Patient GrowthAbove Wisp level 25, reduce future Empower price growth from 13% to 12% per level at rank 1, down to 8% at rank 5. Cheaper Recruitment still applies.Unlocks at Rift 40
Sixth CompanionChoose up to 6 Active Wisps in your Formation and saved presets. Wisps still require recruitment.Unlocks at Rift 75

Bench MentorshipEvery 10 paid recruit or Empower actions give 1 level per rank to the lowest-level other recruited Benched Wisp. Progress resets at Ascend; bonus levels never repeat the award.Unlocks at Rift 35
Steady InstructionAuto-Empower can make 1 extra paid purchase per second per level, up to 5 purchases. Respects each Wisp’s toggle and existing unlock.Unlocks at Rift 45
Wall WisdomAn unwinnable boss can trigger offline retreat 1 minute earlier per level, from 5 minutes to a 1-minute minimum. The 12-hour offline cap stays the same.Unlocks at Rift 50
Early InvitationsRecruitment unlocks arrive 1 Rift earlier per level, down to Rift 1. Permanent Wisp upgrade prices stay the same.Unlocks at Rift 15

Recruitment ReserveAuto-Empower prioritizes the next enabled recruit in your remembered Formation. Until affordable, reserve 20% of its Lumen price per level from other automatic Empowers.Unlocks at Rift 25

locks.text: Swift CharterFuture Swift Ascension levels from level 10 cost 6 times the current level in Prisms. Keeps every existing +4% bonus.Unlocks at Rift 100 · Swift Ascension level 10
Lumen InheritanceKeep 5% of your current Lumen per level when you Ascend, up to 50,000 Lumen per level. An empty wallet stays empty.Unlocks at Rift 15
Veteran RecruitsFuture first recruitment and Ember after Ascend start 1 level higher per rank. Pay only the recruitment price; bonus levels are not paid Empowers.Unlocks at Rift 20
Roster RecallAfter Ascend, recruit one additional remembered Formation member per level who was recruited in the ending run. Uses Veteran Recruits. Pauses when starting Single Star.Unlocks at Rift 25
Charge MemoryKeep 20% of each Wisp’s charge per level through Ascend, up to 100%. Dormant charge waits for recruitment.Unlocks at Rift 30
Lasting BlessingsKeep current Support blessings through Ascend with their existing strength and expiry. Never refreshes or extends a cast.Unlocks at Rift 60
Unbroken RhythmKeep the elapsed part of Auto-Tap and Auto-Empower’s current second through Ascend. Requires their existing Deed unlocks.Unlocks at Rift 40
Familiar PathsStart 1 Rift further ahead per level after Ascend, up to Rift 6. Skipped enemies give no rewards or kill credit.Unlocks at Rift 30
Frontier RecordGain 1 extra Prism per level for each new block of 25 cleared Rifts beyond your rewarded benchmark. Repeated Rifts give no extra award.Unlocks at Rift 50
Ascension DustEvery 20 Prisms earned in an Ascend also gives 1 Mote per level, up to 10 Motes per level. No Prisms are spent.Unlocks at Rift 60
Patient GrowthAbove Wisp level 25, reduce future Empower price growth from 13% to 12% per level at rank 1, down to 8% at rank 5. Cheaper Recruitment still applies.Unlocks at Rift 40
Sixth CompanionChoose up to 6 Active Wisps in your Formation and saved presets. Wisps still require recruitment.Unlocks at Rift 75

Early InvitationsRecruitment unlocks arrive 1 Rift earlier per level, down to Rift 1. Permanent Wisp upgrade prices stay the same.Unlocks at Rift 15

Recruitment ReserveAuto-Empower prioritizes the next enabled recruit in your remembered Formation. Until affordable, reserve 20% of its Lumen price per level from other automatic Empowers.Unlocks at Rift 25

locks.text: Swift CharterFuture Swift Ascension levels from level 10 cost 6 times the current level in Prisms. Keeps every existing +4% bonus.Unlocks at Rift 100 · Swift Ascension level 10
Lumen InheritanceKeep 5% of your current Lumen per level when you Ascend, up to 50,000 Lumen per level. An empty wallet stays empty.Unlocks at Rift 15
Veteran RecruitsFuture first recruitment and Ember after Ascend start 1 level higher per rank. Pay only the recruitment price; bonus levels are not paid Empowers.Unlocks at Rift 20
Roster RecallAfter Ascend, recruit one additional remembered Formation member per level who was recruited in the ending run. Uses Veteran Recruits. Pauses when starting Single Star.Unlocks at Rift 25
Charge MemoryKeep 20% of each Wisp’s charge per level through Ascend, up to 100%. Dormant charge waits for recruitment.Unlocks at Rift 30
Lasting BlessingsKeep current Support blessings through Ascend with their existing strength and expiry. Never refreshes or extends a cast.Unlocks at Rift 60
Unbroken RhythmKeep the elapsed part of Auto-Tap and Auto-Empower’s current second through Ascend. Requires their existing Deed unlocks.Unlocks at Rift 40
Familiar PathsStart 1 Rift further ahead per level after Ascend, up to Rift 6. Skipped enemies give no rewards or kill credit.Unlocks at Rift 30
Frontier RecordGain 1 extra Prism per level for each new block of 25 cleared Rifts beyond your rewarded benchmark. Repeated Rifts give no extra award.Unlocks at Rift 50
Ascension DustEvery 20 Prisms earned in an Ascend also gives 1 Mote per level, up to 10 Motes per level. No Prisms are spent.Unlocks at Rift 60
Patient GrowthAbove Wisp level 25, reduce future Empower price growth from 13% to 12% per level at rank 1, down to 8% at rank 5. Cheaper Recruitment still applies.Unlocks at Rift 40
Sixth CompanionChoose up to 6 Active Wisps in your Formation and saved presets. Wisps still require recruitment.Unlocks at Rift 75

Bench MentorshipEvery 10 paid recruit or Empower actions give 1 level per rank to the lowest-level other recruited Benched Wisp. Progress resets at Ascend; bonus levels never repeat the award.Unlocks at Rift 35
Steady InstructionAuto-Empower can make 1 extra paid purchase per second per level, up to 5 purchases. Respects each Wisp’s toggle and existing unlock.Unlocks at Rift 45
Wall WisdomAn unwinnable boss can trigger offline retreat 1 minute earlier per level, from 5 minutes to a 1-minute minimum. The 12-hour offline cap stays the same.Unlocks at Rift 50
Early InvitationsRecruitment unlocks arrive 1 Rift earlier per level, down to Rift 1. Permanent Wisp upgrade prices stay the same.Unlocks at Rift 15

Recruitment ReserveAuto-Empower prioritizes the next enabled recruit in your remembered Formation. Until affordable, reserve 20% of its Lumen price per level from other automatic Empowers.Unlocks at Rift 25

locks.text: Swift CharterFuture Swift Ascension levels from level 10 cost 6 times the current level in Prisms. Keeps every existing +4% bonus.Unlocks at Rift 100 · Swift Ascension level 10
Lumen InheritanceKeep 5% of your current Lumen per level when you Ascend, up to 50,000 Lumen per level. An empty wallet stays empty.Unlocks at Rift 15
Veteran RecruitsFuture first recruitment and Ember after Ascend start 1 level higher per rank. Pay only the recruitment price; bonus levels are not paid Empowers.Unlocks at Rift 20
Roster RecallAfter Ascend, recruit one additional remembered Formation member per level who was recruited in the ending run. Uses Veteran Recruits. Pauses when starting Single Star.Unlocks at Rift 25
Charge MemoryKeep 20% of each Wisp’s charge per level through Ascend, up to 100%. Dormant charge waits for recruitment.Unlocks at Rift 30
Lasting BlessingsKeep current Support blessings through Ascend with their existing strength and expiry. Never refreshes or extends a cast.Unlocks at Rift 60
Unbroken RhythmKeep the elapsed part of Auto-Tap and Auto-Empower’s current second through Ascend. Requires their existing Deed unlocks.Unlocks at Rift 40
Familiar PathsStart 1 Rift further ahead per level after Ascend, up to Rift 6. Skipped enemies give no rewards or kill credit.Unlocks at Rift 30
Frontier RecordGain 1 extra Prism per level for each new block of 25 cleared Rifts beyond your rewarded benchmark. Repeated Rifts give no extra award.Unlocks at Rift 50
Ascension DustEvery 20 Prisms earned in an Ascend also gives 1 Mote per level, up to 10 Motes per level. No Prisms are spent.Unlocks at Rift 60
Patient GrowthAbove Wisp level 25, reduce future Empower price growth from 13% to 12% per level at rank 1, down to 8% at rank 5. Cheaper Recruitment still applies.Unlocks at Rift 40
Sixth CompanionChoose up to 6 Active Wisps in your Formation and saved presets. Wisps still require recruitment.Unlocks at Rift 75

Bench MentorshipEvery 10 paid recruit or Empower actions give 1 level per rank to the lowest-level other recruited Benched Wisp. Progress resets at Ascend; bonus levels never repeat the award.Unlocks at Rift 35
Steady InstructionAuto-Empower can make 1 extra paid purchase per second per level, up to 5 purchases. Respects each Wisp’s toggle and existing unlock.Unlocks at Rift 45
Wall WisdomAn unwinnable boss can trigger offline retreat 1 minute earlier per level, from 5 minutes to a 1-minute minimum. The 12-hour offline cap stays the same.Unlocks at Rift 50
Early InvitationsRecruitment unlocks arrive 1 Rift earlier per level, down to Rift 1. Permanent Wisp upgrade prices stay the same.Unlocks at Rift 15

Recruitment ReserveAuto-Empower prioritizes the next enabled recruit in your remembered Formation. Until affordable, reserve 20% of its Lumen price per level from other automatic Empowers.Unlocks at Rift 25
